title: Advanced Case Management Manual for Demand Phase
summary: Operational protocols for the demand stage: requesting medical record and billing amendments, auditing for care gaps, missing records and billing discrepancies, identifying liens and subrogation, and cross-referencing case data.

title: Advanced Protocols: Packaging Audits, Subrogation Cuts, DV & CMS Analytics
summary: Case Management supplement: demand package audits and exhibit indexing, ERISA and Medicare subrogation negotiation, diminished value and loss of use claims, and CMS data-stale analytics.

title: Case Management Trainee Handout: Advanced Concepts & Troubleshooting
summary: Trainee handout on operational bottlenecks, how property damage affects injury claims (MIST), navigating liability disputes, and statute of limitations and statutory deadlines.

title: Litigation & ADR Case Management: Operations & Training Guide
summary: Operations manual for litigation case managers: core roles and responsibilities, and the Alternative Dispute Resolution track (mediation, arbitration, settlement conferences) with the key dates and deadlines to track.

title: Operational Conflict Resolution: Intake, Planning & Treatment
summary: Case Management handout on resolving conflicts across the intake, case planning and active treatment phases of a personal injury claim: conflict checks, bottlenecks and fixes, coverage and liability projections, treatment gaps and red flags, a clinical simulation workbook and a revenue and monitoring compliance checklist.

title: Settlement Standoffs, PIP Exhaustion Physics & Claims Algorithms
summary: Case Management handout on advanced negotiation and pre-suit strategy: how claims software (Colossus, ClaimIQ, InjuryIQ) values a demand, PIP exhaustion, EMC vs non-EMC thresholds, adjuster leverage traps, proportional reduction and lien standoffs, the litigation threat, and pre-litigation file hardening.

title: The Personal Injury Lifecycle: Case Manager's Roadmap
summary: Master operational guide mapping the whole personal injury lifecycle for case managers: compliance, retainers and time logging, CMS and verification portals, liability systems, PIP/MedPay mechanics, property damage recovery, firm staff collaboration and the chronological file stages.
